h: Balak Sees the Fire of Torah Overcoming the Emori

p: In the holy Zohar (beginning of this parashah, 184b):
"He saw through the lintel of wisdom, etc.;
and through it sees whoever sees
That is, even among the nations of the world
there are those who look out
And afterward in the holy Zohar (185a):
וְעַל דָּא אֵת כָּל אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה
that it means above and below?
as we have said several times,
alef is the letters of "pele," the Supernal Wonder,
and tav alludes to the World to Come;
that is, that Yisrael captured from the Emori
the vitality and the holy sparks
that they had from the root above.
which is the middah of Tzaddik, foundation of the world,
which flows to the middah of Malchus,
and this is "the princes and rulers below";
that is, they captured this from them:
that it flow to Knesses Yisrael
through the middah of Yesod from the root,
as it is written, "son of Tzippor":
that through the bird he knew;
he saw a flame of fire
then he saw what he saw,
and was afraid of Yisrael, etc."
וְהַיְינוּ עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (תְּהִלִּים קו, יח)
And this is along the lines of what is said (Tehillim 106:18),
And it is the matter of what is written
let it be built and established
and the kingdom return to its former state.'
When they saw the might of Moshe
and the flame of the kingdom,
they said, 'For a fire went out from Cheshbon,
a flame from the city of Sichon, etc.':
and recall Cheshbon, that it be built
behold, a fire went out from Cheshbon;
from the city of Sichon, etc."
And the matter follows what is written
no creature could have conquered it;
and had Sichon been in a weak village,
no man could have conquered him."
what was the strength of Cheshbon
if it was full of gnats?
הֲלֹא הָיוּ יְכוֹלִין לַעֲלוֹת עַל הַחוֹמָה
Could they not have climbed the wall,
וְכֵן מֶה הָיָה חָזְקוֹ שֶׁל סִיחוֹן
And likewise, what was Sichon's strength
if he was in a weak village
But what is meant is the power
of the kelipah that was in them.
יֵשׁ קְדוּשַּׁת דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
there is the holiness of David HaMelech, alav hashalom,
who was a chariot for the middah of Malchus,
and there is also the holiness of the place,
there is also the kelipah of the king,
וְכֵן יֵשׁ גַּם כֵּן קְלִיפַּת הַמָּקוֹם
and likewise there is also the kelipah of the place,
Now Sichon and Og were brothers,
the sons of Achiyah bar Shemchazai
and presumably Sichon too was born
And regarding Og it is brought in the Gemara (Zevachim 113b)
that a miracle was done for him,
and he stood at the side of the Ark,
And regarding Sichon, who also escaped from the Flood
presumably he fled to Eretz Yisrael;
the place of the nine kav of wisdom
from the power of the Oral Torah,
And regarding Og it is brought in the holy Zohar (there)
that all the kings of the world
could not wage war against him
because of the strength of Bashan;
and it is brought in the gloss of Rabbi Chaim Vital
וְהַיְינוּ עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמַר (בְּאָבוֹת ב, ח)
that is, according to what it says (in Avos 2:8),
רַבִּי שִׁמְעוֹן בֶּן נְתַנְאֵל יְרֵא חֵטְא
"Rabbi Shimon ben Nesanel, one who fears sin";
and his power was from the side of fear.
מִגְּמָרָא עֲבוֹדָה זָרָה יט, א וְעוֹד)
from the Gemara Avodah Zarah 19a, and elsewhere);
from the holiness of the Oral Torah,
and they are the two kings of the Emori.
was against the holiness of the place.
And about this the verse says,
"For a fire went out from Cheshbon,"
עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (עוֹבַדְיָה א, יח)
along the lines of what is said (Ovadiah 1:18),
"And the house of Yaakov shall be fire";
the holiness of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
who is the vav, the "true letter,"
"from His right hand a fiery law."
"And the house of Yosef a flame":
that is, Yosef, the middah of Tzaddik,
who flows to the middah of Malchus,
שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת קְדוּשַּׁת תּוֹרָה שֶׁבְּעַל פֶּה
which is the aspect of the holiness of the Oral Torah;
and it is called by the name "flame,"
And this is what it says:
if we say that Cheshbon be built,
behold, a fire went out from Cheshbon,
which was against the holiness of the place;
behold, a flame went out from the city of Sichon;
against the holiness of the Oral Torah,

p: And this is what Balak saw
"what Yisrael had done to the Emori."
that he saw a flame of fire
and burned the wings of the bird;
that "a flame burns up the wicked":
that the holiness of the Kingdom of Heaven,
that is, the middah of Malchus,
brought to an end the power of Sichon and Og,
whose power was from the kelipah
And this is what it says:
וְזֶה עִנְיַן מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
And this is the matter of what is written in the holy Zohar:
"When they saw the might of Moshe
and the flame of the kingdom,
they said, 'For a fire went out from Cheshbon,
a flame from the city of Sichon.'"
is the holiness of the Written Torah,
was the root of the Written Torah;
the aspect of the Written Torah,
which was the power of Sichon.
regarding the making of the bird
so that there would be in it
something against the holiness of the three Avos:
silver against the aspect of love
against the middah of "the Fear of Yitzchak";
which is the middah of Yaakov Avinu,
who is the root of repairing the blemish of the serpent;
which indicates the World to Come,
that is, that the blemish of the serpent be repaired
And he was of the three kelipos
that oppose the holiness of the Avos.

that is, the blemish of the serpent,
